<thought>The tool returned many candidate fragments, many of which contain charges or unrealistic substructures. The task asks for the SMILES strings for the connected fragments of the compound, i.e., neutral fragments that could be joined to reconstruct the original molecule. I will filter the list to keep only neutral, chemically reasonable SMILES strings. I will validate each candidate with the validate_smiles tool and retain those that are valid and have no formal charge.</thought>
<action>validate_smiles</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "C[CH-]C([NH-])=O"}</action_input>
